```{r}
xen1_label_transfer <- readRDS("results/objects/xen1_label_transfer.rds")
```

```{r}
p_original <- DimPlot(
  xen1_label_transfer,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "cell_type",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  label.size = 3,
  pt.size = 1,
  alpha = 1
) +
  ggtitle("Original annotation") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_transfer <- DimPlot(
  xen1_label_transfer,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "predicted.id",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  label.size = 3,
  pt.size = 1,
  alpha = 1
) +
  ggtitle("Anchor-based label transfer") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```
